blocks.text: Sometimes, the best place to stay in the city is one that makes you feel at home from the moment you arrive. At Somerset Gorordo Cebu, one of Cebu City’s newest hospitality destinations, that feeling begins with a warm welcome from the staff and continues through thoughtfully designed rooms, satisfying breakfast options, and spaces where guests can work, relax, or simply take a break from the pace of Cebu City. Located at the corner of Gorordo Avenue and Archbishop Reyes Avenue, Somerset Gorordo Cebu brings serviced-residence living into a convenient urban setting.
